ext_name.description: Store and toolbar name. Keep the brand 'Streams Reader' untranslated. At most 75 characters.

ext_description.message: Listen to any article in Streams Reader. One click sends the page you're on to your library and starts reading it aloud.
ext_description.description: Store summary and chrome://extensions description. At most 132 characters.

action_title.message: Read this page in Streams Reader

menu_read_page.description: Context menu item on a page. Chrome nests it under the extension name.

menu_read_selection.description: Context menu item when text is selected.

menu_read_link.description: Context menu item on a link: read the page the link points to.

error_restricted.message: Streams Reader can't read this kind of page.
error_restricted.description: Toolbar tooltip when the browser does not let extensions read the page (settings, Web Store).

error_empty.description: Toolbar tooltip when there is no text to read (or nothing selected).

error_too_large.message: This page is too large to send to Streams Reader.
error_too_large.description: Toolbar tooltip when the page is over the size limit.

error_failed.message: Couldn't read this page. Reload it and try again.
error_failed.description: Toolbar tooltip for any other failure.
